title: Memory Rooms spot capture v1
description: How a spot's photos were taken, and the hints for placing them (CONTRACTS.md 8). `guided` = the shot guide's corner shots (the default; a spot without `capture` is guided). `freeform` = old photos in any order (up to 40), which the render session has to place itself: James can help with a rough outline of the room (`layout`) and viewpoints (`views`: where he stood and which way he faced). Metres in the scene frame of CONTRACTS.md 1 (x east, z south, y up); `yaw` uses rotY's convention (degrees about +y: 0 = looking south (+z), 90 = east, 180 = north, 270 = west). Captions are PER PHOTO (`captions`, keyed by photo number), not per viewpoint: a photo can have one without being placed. Validated by src/memory-rooms/capture/freeform.js (JS only: the phone and the Worker write it).

era.description: When this was, in James's words: "lived here 2019–2021".

captions.description: Photo number ("1"…"40") → a short caption ("from the bed"). Keys checked by freeform.js.

outline.description: The room's walls as a polygon (inner faces), 3–64 corners, either direction, simple. A rough sketch: metres are only right when sizeKnown.

sizeKnown.description: true when James typed the size ("about 4 × 3") or the outline came from a measured plan; false = proportions only.

offset.description: From outline[edge] toward the next corner, to the opening's near side.

conf.description: exact = he knows he stood right there facing that way; rough = about there.
